name: Coc dam
summary: Cóc dầm is on the sweet side of Con Market’s indoor counters, on the 19 Jun 2019 roundup, with chè, sinh tố, and me dầm. The page does not describe the dressing.
origin: Named at Con Market. A recipe was not printed.
howToEat: The 2019 page names cóc dầm and does not describe a method. Check on arrival.
where: Indoor counters at Con Market. The 2019 roundup says to use the indoor court from 07:00 to 15:00. Later market pages do not restate that split.
seoTitle: Coc dam — a Con Market snack name
seoDescription: Con Market’s 2019 indoor list names cóc dầm with the sweets. The page does not describe the dressing. Check on arrival.
